name: Shinpu no Oshigoto
source:
Main character gets a temporary job of a priest in a school of missionary system. Girls believe that he's the real priest and confess all the sexual problems to him. It looks like this job is not bad after all.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在一所教会系统的学校里得到了一份临时神父的工作。女孩们以为他是真正的神父，向他倾诉所有的性问题。看起来这份工作还不错。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
